newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker seen a shade softer on low crude.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker seen a shade softer on low crude.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Monday were seen to be a shade softer in a thin market along with lower crude values, traders said.
Majors were quoting at $126 a tonne for 180-cst and at $121 for 380-cst. Independents were lower at $124 for 180-cst and at $119 for 380-cst. Levels were about $1.00 below Friday's.

Independents said lower Fujairah bunker prices were taking away much business from Singapore, while majors said the current economic slowdown is seeing fewer ships stopping in Singapore. MDO and gasoil prices were also slightly softer at $224-$228 and $235-$240 respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3082)
